citations.bibliography: Mudhar HS et al. A Multicenter Study Validates the WHO 2022 Classification for Conjunctival Melanocytic Intraepithelial Lesions With Clinical and Prognostic Relevance. Lab Invest. 2024;104:100281.
citations.exact_passage: The fourth WHO Classification of Eye Tumors (WHO-EYE04) proposed a C-MIL classification, capturing the progression of noninvasive neoplastic melanocytes from low- to high-grade lesions, onto melanoma in situ (MIS), and then to invasive melanoma. citations.does_not_support: No automatic ontology promotion, universal cytologic atypia across every grade, or retrospective erasure of WHO-EYE04 terminology.
citations.limitations: Validation study of classification reproducibility, not the WHO volume itself.
citations.conflicts_or_supersession: WHO-EYE05 revises prospective classification while WHO-EYE04 remains necessary for historical context.
